verdict.rationale: Onboarding workflows are a fair axis for a banking platform, but the evidence pack never documents an onboarding queue, pending-application status reasons, document resubmission, or a split between customer and bank decisions. The only nearby items say that a legal representative registers the Organization and that account opening is free. Neither is an onboarding-queue capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can work the onboarding queue — see why an application is pending, supply additional documents, and understand which decisions are mine versus the bank's
